item.title: [−2] Kerala among states at risk of water stress as reservoirs fall short of capacity after monsoon
item.description:
Signal: weak monsoon or sowing. 5 reports from Bhaskar English, The Goan, Deccan Herald and 2 more. Related: “Monsoon rainfall 12.6% below normal this year: 305 Maharashtra, 217 Karnataka talukas declared drought-hit;...”. New in the last 24 hours.

Agri & fertilisers: headwind (−2) — Crop output at risk

Why it matters: Poor rains hurt harvests and rural incomes, weighing on rural demand and raising food inflation.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1, Growth outlook −1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] India-EU trade deal to save €4 billion a year in customs duties, German minister says
item.description:
Signal: trade deal or tariff relief for India (India). 43 reports from The Hindu, Telegraph India, Reuters and 32 more. Related: “‘It's never done till it's done’: Jaishankar on India-US trade deal”. Ongoing: also reported on 5 of the previous 7 days (first 18 Oct).
